newsitem.title: USA: Aviation Distributors adjusts Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Aviation Distributors adjusts Q2 results.

text.p: Aviation Distributors Inc said late Thursday that it was revising its second quarter results to reflect the reversal of a $240,000 transaction that will now be booked in its third quarter.
The company said the change does not affect earnings per share or net income for the second quarter, and will have only a minimal effect on its sales for that period.
The company had announced the results for that period ended June 30 on July 21, showing net income of $608 million, or $0.20 per share, on sales of $10.33 million.
After the adjustments, the net income and earnings per share remain the same on sales of $10.09 million.
Aviation Distributors is an aircraft part redistributors and inventory management service provider.
